facts.name: Traci Perry
facts.role: Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller
facts.assignment: Citrus County circuit and county court clerk services.

mailing_address: Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller; attention department or person
contact.contact_note: Civil fax and administrative fax are distinct. The contact page directs general questions to its public-records portal; no general email address is published in the reviewed contact blocks. Inquiry forms and fax are not established filing channels.

filing.summary: Clerk FAQ directs attorney filings through the ePortal. Upload individual pleadings separately. Ordinary paper follow-up is not required, except originals required by law/rule; see additional FAQ for its list.

proposed_orders.summary: Clerk FAQ describes attachment with a pleading or delivery to clerk/judge. Individual judge instructions separately prescribe portal or email routes and editable formats; preserve these source-specific instructions rather than treating the generic FAQ as a universal order-submission rule.

filing_status.summary: Check portal notifications and My Filings status, then SCORSS for accepted records. FAQ distinguishes receipt from processing and warns processing may take three days; it states a five-business-day pending-queue correction period. These are the clerk page’s statements, not independently reconciled legal deadlines.

summons.summary: Additional FAQ directs e-filing the unexecuted summons with payment; attorney retrieves the issued image through SCORSS. Return of service is e-filed.

chambers_communications.summary: Civil inquiries: published clerk number, option 5; general inquiries via linked portal/contact forms. Portal technical support is separate from clerk contacts. Include a self-addressed stamped envelope when requesting return of an original document.

facts.summary: Clerk identity, civil contacts, two office locations/hours, practical filing routes and three county resource destinations reviewed.
gaps: No general clerk email or named personal assistant established in the reviewed contact pages.

conflicts.subject: General FAQ and judge-specific proposed-order routes
statements: Clerk FAQ permits an order attached with a pleading or submitted directly to clerk/judge.
Reviewed Citrus judges prescribe differing dedicated email or portal submission routes and formats.
conflicts.disposition: Keep each source and its scope; do not decide which instruction controls.

review_scope.collected: Seven complete official HTML pages, extracted text and link inventories; two records-search destination HTTP checks.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contact and civil service blocks; filing FAQ practical routing/status; additional FAQ originals and summons routes; resource destination links and official property-appraiser identity.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Specialized forms, fee schedules, merits requirements and linked legal authorities. Records search functionality not exercised.
